objective: paired final score-margin improvement over frozen champion continuation

TRAIN_THIRD: full tuple when enabled and already affordable; disabled in provisional parameters

searched_joint_execution.MOVE: canonical shortest-path target inherited from the selected macro or champion candidate
searched_joint_execution.PICK: seed reservation step of a selected planting macro
searched_joint_execution.CHOP: all champion chop candidates remain available; young optimizer trees are protected until size 4
searched_joint_execution.TRAIN: champion second-troll choice plus optional optimizer third-troll choice

exactness_boundary: The online candidate uses a bounded planting-sequence surrogate to decide whether to override the champion. Every emitted command is replayed by the project referee gates. The full stochastic turn-300 optimum is not claimed.
